semiconductor_relevance: High — Grand Technology Inc. specializes in application-specific software and consulting services tailored for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Founded in 1996, Grand Technology Inc. is a leading provider of application-specific software and hardware solutions for the semiconductor industry. The company focuses on developing tools that support the design and testing of chips and micro systems, along with offering consulting and training services.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Grand Technology Inc. maintains strong relationships with semiconductor companies in Taiwan.
